title: Fadar Gilashin Madubin
intro: Ka yi tunanin ƙasa mai nisa mai wadata da ɗaukaka inda ake bauta wa rana maimakon Mahaliccinta. Wasiƙa ta iso ɗauke da kira wanda ba za a iya yin watsi da shi ba, kuma tafiya ta fara zuwa kotu mafi girma fiye da yadda aka gani a da. A can, mafarki zai bayyana ta hanyar bene da ke yaudarar idanu, kuma ɗan lokaci na haske zai canza komai.
clues: Na yi mulki a kan wata ƙasa mai wadata wadda mutanenta suka yi sujada ga rana maimakon Allah.
Na sami wata wasiƙa mai daraja da ke kirana kada in ɗaukaka kaina sai dai in miƙa wuya ga Allah.
Na tuntuɓi majalisara kuma na zaɓi diflomasiyya da farko, na aika da kyauta don gwada wanda ya aiko.
Na zo wurin Sulaiman, aka gabatar mini da kursiyina a ɓoye domin a gwada gane ni.
Na shiga wani babban fada wanda na yi zaton na yi zaton na yi amfani da shi a matsayin ruwa mai zurfi.
Na bayyana sallamata ga Sulaiman ga Allah, Ubangijin talikai.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: 'Yar'uwar Musa
Matar Abu Lahab
Matar Nuhu
Bilqis, Sarkin Saba
Zulaikha, Matar Al-Aziz

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye shi a cikin zurfin teku
Na yi fama da rashin lafiya da kuma rashin iyali tsawon shekaru
An umarce shi da ya yi hadaya da ƙaunataccen yaro a mafarki
An gwada shi da kursiyin da aka ɓoye da kuma fadar gilashi
An jefa shi cikin wuta mai zafi don karya gumaka
trial.answer: An gwada shi da kursiyin da aka ɓoye da kuma fadar gilashi

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: An gina Jirgin a kan ruwa
Kogon mafaka ga masu barci
Bene na fadar lu'ulu'u (Sarh)
Kogin Nilu a lokacin da aka yi hijira
Wutar da masu bautar gumaka suka shirya

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An haɗiye shi da ƙasa tare da taskokina
Ya ci gaba da kasancewa cikin rashin imani kuma an hallaka shi tare da mutanena
An miƙa wuya ga Sulaiman ga Allah, Ubangijin talikai
An nutsar da ni a cikin teku yayin da yake bin muminai
An mayar da shi dutse saboda karya Asabar
outcome.answer: An miƙa wuya ga Sulaiman ga Allah, Ubangijin talikai

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
